Logarithmic measure of earthquake magnitude based on seismic wave amplitude; each whole number is 10x larger amplitude.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The Restless Earth — a core area of GCSE Geography.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

The Restless Earth brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Restless Earth.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How is the dependency ratio calculated?
options: The dependency ratio is the number of unemployed people in a country.
The dependency ratio is the number of children per family.
(Population aged 0-14 plus population aged 65+) divided by population aged 15-64, multiplied by 100 — comparing dependants to the working-age population.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.

mcqs.q: Why does oceanic crust subduct beneath continental crust?
options: Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
Oceanic crust is denser (basaltic) than continental crust (granitic), so when they collide the denser oceanic plate sinks into the mantle, forming a trench and volcanic arc.
Oceanic crust subducts because the ocean pushes it down with its weight.

mcqs.q: Why is 'renewable' not the same as 'clean' energy?
options: Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
All renewable energy sources are clean and have no environmental impact.
Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.

Renewable means the source replenishes naturally on human timescales; clean means low environmental/health impact. Hydropower is renewable but floods habitats; bioenergy is renewable but can drive deforestation.
